nodes.name: WhatsApp Verify (GET)
nodes.notes: Meta calls this once when you register the webhook URL in the Meta App dashboard, and again any time you re-verify. Must echo back hub.challenge as plain text if hub.verify_token matches WHATSAPP_VERIFY_TOKEN.

nodes.name: WhatsApp Webhook (POST)
nodes.notes: Same path as the GET verify node above -- n8n registers them as separate routes because the HTTP method differs. NOT SIGNATURE-VERIFIED YET: Meta signs this body with X-Hub-Signature-256 (HMAC-SHA256 using the Meta App Secret); this workflow doesn't check it, so anyone who discovers this URL could POST a forged message. Same class of gap as the tenant-onboarding webhook -- see KNOWN_ISSUES.md. Add signature verification before relying on this beyond a sandbox test number.

nodes.name: Respond Ack
nodes.notes: Meta expects a fast 200 regardless of what's inside -- retries aggressively (and eventually disables the webhook) if it doesn't get one quickly. Responds immediately; processing continues on the other output.

parameters.query:
-- The agency this WhatsApp number belongs to (Settings -> WhatsApp phone number id),
-- with its slug, which Elliot (workflow 01) needs. No row = unknown number:
-- 'If Tenant Found' sends it to the audit log.
select ac.tenant_id, ac.whatsapp_phone_number_id, t.slug as tenant_slug, t.name as tenant_name
from ai_config ac
join tenants t on t.id = ac.tenant_id
where ac.whatsapp_phone_number_id = $1 and t.status = 'active'
limit 1;

nodes.name: Upsert Contact
nodes.notes: Keeps an existing name rather than overwriting it with WhatsApp's profile name on every message -- a contact who already gave a fuller name via email/chat shouldn't have it clobbered by whatever they set as their WhatsApp display name.

parameters.query:
-- Same pattern as 16's "Get or Create Conversation (Email)": one conversation per
-- (tenant, contact, channel), reused forever, not split by status or thread.
-- WhatsApp has no thread id to match on the way email has gmail_thread_id --
-- a contact's phone number IS the thread, so matching on contact_id is enough.
with existing as (
  select id from conversations
  where tenant_id = $1 and contact_id = $2 and channel = 'whatsapp'
  limit 1
),
inserted as (
  insert into conversations (tenant_id, contact_id, channel)
  select $1, $2, 'whatsapp'
  where not exists (select 1 from existing)
  returning id
)
select id from existing
union all
select id from inserted;

nodes.notes: Set the real credential: an HTTP Header Auth credential named "WhatsApp Cloud API token", header name "Authorization", value "Bearer <your Meta system-user access token>". The same credential as workflow 27; one token covers every agency's number.

parameters.query:
-- 0048: Meta sent several messages in one delivery and only the first is
-- answered. Logged so it appears in the alerts and someone reads the chat.
insert into audit_log (tenant_id, actor_type, actor_id, event_type, details)
select ac.tenant_id, 'system', 'workflow_25', 'whatsapp_unanswered_failed',
       jsonb_build_object('messages_not_answered', $2::int, 'from_wa_id', $3::text)
from ai_config ac where ac.whatsapp_phone_number_id = nullif($1, '') limit 1;
